description: Steps of one saved workout from the Garmin library in readable form: name, sport, description and one line per step (warm-up, repeats, duration or distance, target in pace/HR/power/cadence), plus estimated duration and distance. Use it to show what a planned session contains, or before changing it with create_workout; to find workouts or what is on the calendar use list_workouts. An id that no longer exists in Garmin Connect returns a NOT_FOUND error.

id.description: Workout id from list_workouts or workout_id from get_activity

name: get_workout
title: Get a planned workout
